label: 🌀 BIAS (2.0)
description:
Extreme percussive / tonal additive wavefolding oscillator. Claude's attempt to copy the Noise Engineering Basimilus Iteritas Alia's Skin/Liquid engines from public descriptions. Six oscillators, each has its own envelope. The sum is folded, and the folder gets its own envelope after it.

[[video]]

Clean room: no Noise Engineering code, table or sample is used; the architecture follows their public description.

COLOR  Harm: one tone at the left, a second over the first quarter, then four upper modes with decays that stretch, then their levels rise
SHAPE  Morph: every oscillator through sine, triangle, saw and square, two neighbours blended
SWEEP  Spread: the upper ratios from 1-2-3-4-5-6 to the primes 1-2-3-5-7-11
CONTOUR  Fold: first three quarters lower the folder's threshold; from 96 the folded peaks strike as pulses

DECAY
10 ms to 4 s, exponential. 127 is a free-running drone.

[PUNCH]
On = Liquid: a +24 semitone pitch envelope on the clock, so all six oscillators drop together.
Off = Skin. Parameter-lockable per trig.

[GATE]
On holds the six envelopes at half level while the note is held.

Heavy: 96 % of a TONE voice at the worst setting, so keep an eye on six of them at once.
